Definition: to turn aside, i.e. (literally) to depart, (figuratively) be perverse
BiblicalUsage: 1) to depart, turn aside; 1a) (Qal) to depart; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to go wrong, go crooked; 1b2) devious, perverse (participle); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to be lost from view; 1c2) to become devious
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
